description: This file defines classes and methods for fetching and processing bill text data from Congress.gov, including query parameter handling, data representation, and data extraction logic.

classes.name: CongressBillTextQueryParams
classes.description: Defines query parameters for fetching bill text, including URL list handling.

classes.name: CongressBillTextData
classes.description: Represents the fetched bill text data, including content, filename, and error info.

classes.name: CongressBillTextFetcher
classes.description: Handles the process of transforming queries, extracting data asynchronously, and formatting results.

methods.name: transform_query
methods.description: Converts a dictionary of parameters into a CongressBillTextQueryParams instance.

methods.name: aextract_data
methods.description: Asynchronously fetches bill text data from provided URLs, handling PDF encoding and errors.

methods.name: transform_data
methods.description: Transforms raw fetched data into structured CongressBillTextData instances.
